main_result.title: The exact predictable-weight denominator envelope is now implemented with breakpoint water-filling and passes randomized numerical checks; prospective equal-size exposure blocks are valid only with outcome-predictable admission/completion and target a distinct exposure estimand.
main_result.regression_reproduction: At 1% zero mismatch, exact versus conservative first-process counts reproduced as 348/350 for equal weights, 556/560 for alternating 0.25/1, 895/903 for repeating 1/16..1, and 1822/1840 for nine 0.1 plus one 1.
main_result.runtime: After precomputation, exact endpoint evaluation was ~3.4-4.2 ms through n=5000 in the local Python microbenchmark; five-lambda setup grew from ~0.9 ms at n=50 to ~264 ms at n=5000 and ~1.07 s at n=20000. The research prototype is not incremental, so streaming deployment must not rebuild from scratch every observation without cost accounting.
main_result.blockization: Adaptive decisions between already completed blocks are compatible with an average-conditional-mean target. Within-block outcome-dependent completion is not: B=1 with Y~Bernoulli(0.5) retained only when Y=0 yields observed completed-block mean 0 despite underlying mean 0.5. Equal-process, equal-block, and equal-exposure/request reliability must be named separately.
public_alignment: Kahan et al. 2023: participant/exposure-average and cluster-average estimands differ by weighting and can diverge under informative cluster size.
Williamson et al. 2008 and related informative-cluster-size literature: outcome-related cluster size can make naive marginal inference misleading.
Chugg and Ramdas 2025: average conditional means of bounded nonstationary streams are legitimate confidence-sequence targets.

measurement_validity_rules: Weights used by the exact weighted endpoint must be fixed before the current score and respect the predeclared normalization cap.
Do not substitute final realized process size when process duration can react to current outcomes.
For fixed-size blocks, admission may depend on past blocks, but completion of an admitted block cannot be selected by its own score without a separately proved missingness/selection correction.
A valid actual-policy exposure estimate does not identify a counterfactual forced-continuation population and does not replace equal-process reliability.
Numerical validation supports the implementation only; the mathematical validity claim remains scoped to the predecessor supermartingale/envelope derivation.

operational_incident.corrective_rule: All remaining connector discovery/use in this invocation is read-only unless writing an explicitly authorized evaluation state/output or own receipt file.

scope_guards: Runtime figures and endpoint-width gains are local synthetic microbenchmarks, not production measurements.
The exact weighted endpoint controls a time-varying predictable-weight average conditional mean, not automatically a stable population mismatch probability.
The blockization result does not solve nonignorable missingness or identify outcomes for requests that never exist after termination.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.

frontier.action: Add an incremental/batched breakpoint update so streaming exact-endpoint monitoring avoids O(n log n) full rebuild per observation; validate against the frozen batch implementation.
Derive a fail-closed block score for admitted blocks interrupted by infrastructure failure, separating predictable/exogenous interruption from potentially outcome-related censoring.
Compare equal-process and actual-exposure reliability jointly under informative-size stress so the estimand gap is measured instead of silently converted into weighting bias.
Compare the exact predictable-weight envelope with public importance-weighted/time-uniform methods under the identical target and predictability contract.
Continue public trace search for token-to-score/sign propagation under repeated inference.

frontier.exact_next_action: Implement an append-oriented incremental exact-envelope component or a safe batch-refresh strategy, verify it is pathwise identical to the current breakpoint batch solver, and quantify rebuild amortization before any deployment recommendation.
